system.description:
You wrap your weapons in a golden silk and strike out with reckless abandon. Make two melee taijutsu (or ninjutsu) attacks against a target creature, dealing your [Weapon Damage]. If you scored at least one hit, you force them to make a Dexterity saving throw as your golden webs are left all over them. On a failure, you snap your webs back tightening them, and forcefully move them 10 feet into a direction of your choice along the ground, while you also move up to 10 feet into a space that can hold you. You can move in the same or opposite directions. This movement cannot trigger attacks of opportunities.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, increase the damage by 1d6 for each attack. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the damage by 1d6 for each attack.
